sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会做DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上也要带300件你最珍爱的传家宝去上班，把DJ台变成一个美丽的、有50年历史的文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: To much of the outside world,
sentences.zh: 对外界的许多人来说，

sentences.en: Hamas' decision to murder hundreds of Israelis and trigger a war that has since killed many thousands of its own people looks like a historic miscalculation,
sentences.zh: 哈马斯决定谋杀数百名以色列人并引发一场后来夺去了数千名本国人民生命的战争，看起来像是一个历史性的重大误算，

sentences.en: one that could soon result in the destruction of Hamas itself.
sentences.zh: 这个误算可能很快导致哈马斯自身的灭亡。

sentences.en: My colleague Ben Hubbard has been reporting on that decision and the deliberate calculations that went into it Tuesday, November 14th.
sentences.zh: 我的同事本·哈伯德一直在报道这一决定及其背后的深思熟虑，时间是11月14日，星期二。

sentences.en: Ben, since October 7th, since Hamas breached Israel's border and killed 1,200 people, according to Israel, the vast majority of them civilians,
sentences.zh: 本，自10月7日以来，据以色列称，哈马斯突破以色列边境并杀害了1200人，其中绝大多数是平民，

sentences.en: I think a really important question has largely gone unanswered, which is why?
sentences.zh: 我认为一个非常重要的问题在很大程度上一直没有得到回答，那就是为什么？

sentences.en: Why undertake such a horrifying terror attack that entailed the mass murder of noncombatants?
sentences.zh: 为什么要进行这样一场骇人听闻、涉及大规模谋杀非战斗人员的恐怖袭击？

sentences.en: And why do that when Hamas had to understand on some level that it would trigger an overwhelming reprisal from Israel
sentences.zh: 当哈马斯在某种程度上必然明白这会引发以色列排山倒海般的报复时，为什么还要这么做？

sentences.en: that would end the lives of so many Palestinian civilians, which is exactly what's happened?
sentences.zh: 那将终结如此多巴勒斯坦平民的生命，而这正是已经发生的事情。

sentences.en: This was a highly planned and highly organized attack that clearly had a strategy behind it.
sentences.zh: 这是一次高度计划、高度有组织的袭击，背后显然有着一套战略。

sentences.en: So what was it?
sentences.zh: 那么，战略是什么？

sentences.en: That's what I set out to understand.
sentences.zh: 这就是我着手去理解的事情。

sentences.en: After the attack, I think everybody was asking that question of why would Hamas, which is sort of ruling in Gaza and has this control,
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后，我想每个人都在问这个问题：为什么哈马斯，它在加沙执政并拥有这种控制权，

sentences.en: and why would they suddenly do something like this that was actually described by one of my colleagues as a suicide attack on itself?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们会突然做出这样的事，甚至被我的一位同事形容为针对自身的自杀式袭击？

sentences.en: Basically, was the movement trying to destroy itself?
sentences.zh: 基本上，这个运动是在试图自我毁灭吗？

sentences.en: And so we wanted to sort of figure out, you know, how did Hamas get to the point in terms of capabilities where it could launch this,
sentences.zh: 所以我们想弄清楚，你知道，哈马斯是如何在能力方面发展到能够发动这次袭击的，

sentences.en: which was a much, much more sophisticated and complicated attack than we had ever seen them carry out before, despite the decades and decades that they've been fighting Israel.
sentences.zh: 与他们几十年来与以色列的战斗相比，这是我们见过的规模大得多、也复杂得多的袭击。

sentences.en: And then also, why?
sentences.zh: 然后还有，为什么？

sentences.en: Like, how did they get to the point where they made the decision that of the kinds of attacks that they could do for whatever it is that they wanted to achieve, why this?
sentences.zh: 比如，他们是怎么走到这一步的：在他们能发动的各种袭击中，无论他们的目标是什么，为什么偏偏是这次袭击？

sentences.en: Not a very easy thing to answer.
sentences.zh: 这不是一件很容易回答的事。

sentences.en: It's completely unrealistic that we would be able to call up the leaders of Hamas in Gaza who plotted and carried out this attack.
sentences.zh: 我们能够打电话给策划并实施了这次袭击的加沙哈马斯领导人，这是完全不现实的。

sentences.en: I mean, certainly by the time that we were asking this question, they were hiding away in their bunkers somewhere,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然，当我们提出这个问题的时候，他们正躲在某处的地堡里，

sentences.en: getting ready to fight Israel, which was making it very clear it was going to do a ground incursion.
sentences.zh: 准备与以色列作战，而以色列已经明确表示将进行地面入侵。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's sort of no way to talk to these people.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，基本上没有办法跟这些人对话。

sentences.en: But Hamas has leaders in other places.
sentences.zh: 但哈马斯在其他地方也有领导人。

sentences.en: You have the people in Gaza who sort of run the show there, and then they have people from their more political operations who are based in other parts of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 你在加沙有那些负责那里事务的人，然后他们有来自中东其他地方的更偏向政治运作的人员。

sentences.en: There's a number of them who are in Beirut.
sentences.zh: 他们当中有很多人在贝鲁特。

sentences.en: There's a number of them who are in Qatar.
sentences.zh: 他们当中有很多人在卡塔尔。

sentences.en: So I packed my bags and left Istanbul and first went to Beirut.
sentences.zh: 所以我收拾行装离开伊斯坦布尔，首先去了贝鲁特。

sentences.en: With the understanding that you could meet with them, I think it would surprise people to think that you can just meet with the senior leaders of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 在可以与他们会面的前提下，我想人们会觉得可以随便与哈马斯的高级领导人会面是一件令人惊讶的事。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, they're sort of like political people from any other political party.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，他们有点像任何其他政党的政治人物。

sentences.en: They have offices and they have aides and you call them up and you take an appointment and you figure out where you're going to meet them and you, you know, go to the office.
sentences.zh: 他们有办公室，有助手，你打电话过去，预约时间，弄清楚你要在哪里与他们会面，然后，你知道的，去办公室。

sentences.en: And so we got in touch with a number of them and they said, yeah, yeah, come in and we'll have a chat.
sentences.zh: 所以我们和他们中的几个人取得了联系，他们说，行，行，进来聊聊吧。

sentences.en: And they told us to meet them at this restaurant that's kind of well known in the suburbs of Beirut.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们在贝鲁特郊区一家挺有名的餐厅碰面。

sentences.en: And we actually got in their car and they drove us to the sort of compound where we went in with a sort of big metal gate that opens when you go in.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上坐上了他们的车，他们把我们带到了某种大院，进去的时候有一个很大的铁门会打开。

sentences.en: And we went in and we just basically sat in a room with some couches and we talked.
sentences.zh: 我们进去了，基本上就是坐在一间有沙发的房间里开始交谈。

sentences.en: And then a few days later, I went to Doha, capital of Qatar, sort of on the other side of the Middle East and the Persian Gulf.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我去了多哈，卡塔尔的首都，也就是中东和波斯湾的另一边。

sentences.en: Again, we get in touch with, you know, the Hamas officials that we know are there.
sentences.zh: 同样，我们跟我们知道在那里的哈马斯官员取得了联系。

sentences.en: And the first person that we talked to is, was actually an aide to Ismail Haniyeh, who was the head of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 我们交谈的第一个人，实际上是哈马斯领导人伊斯梅尔·哈尼亚的助手。

sentences.en: And he says, well, let's meet at the Sheraton, the hotel sort of on the waterfront.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，我们在喜来登酒店见吧，就是海滨那家酒店。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I go there and we meet and have a long chat with him, asking him basically all about sort of the attack and before the attack and why the attack.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我去了那里，我们见面并跟他进行了长时间的交谈，基本上问了他所有关于袭击、袭击前以及为什么发动袭击的问题。

sentences.en: And then we actually get in his car and he drives us to the Hamas office.
sentences.zh: 然后我们真的上了他的车，他开车把我们带到了哈马斯办公室。

sentences.en: It's in sort of a nice villa in an affluent neighborhood, kind of on the outskirts of the city, has a big wall around it.
sentences.zh: 它位于城市边缘一个富裕社区的一栋漂亮的别墅里，周围有一堵高墙。

sentences.en: No sign, no indication to anybody coming by sort of who is there, who works there.
sentences.zh: 没有招牌，没有任何迹象向路过的人表明谁在那里，谁在那里工作。

sentences.en: We meet one of the members of sort of the senior leadership body, the Politburo, Khalil Haye.
sentences.zh: 我们见到了高级领导机构政治局的成员之一，哈利勒·哈亚。

sentences.en: And again, we're sitting in a large room with, you know, couches and somebody brings us tea and coffee and we start talking.
sentences.zh: 同样，我们坐在一间有沙发的大房间里，有人给我们端来茶和咖啡，我们开始交谈。

sentences.en: And after you have all these conversations with these leaders of Hamas, what did they tell you about this question of why?
sentences.zh: 在与这些哈马斯领导人进行了所有这些对话之后，关于“为什么”这个问题，他们对你说了什么？

sentences.en: This question that you have come here to try to understand the logic of this attack, if we can apply that word to what happened.
sentences.zh: 你来到这里试图理解这次袭击逻辑的问题，如果我们可以把这个词应用到所发生的事情上的话。

sentences.en: The basic idea that they all kept coming back to is they felt that the Palestinian cause was basically fading away.
sentences.zh: 他们一直反复提及的基本想法是，他们觉得巴勒斯坦的事业基本上正在消亡。

sentences.en: That there were aspects of this conflict that were approaching a point of no return.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突的某些方面正在接近一个不归路。

sentences.en: And if they sort of passed that point, then it was all over.
sentences.zh: 如果他们越过了那个点，那就一切都完了。

sentences.en: And also this feeling that nobody really cared.
sentences.zh: 还有这种感觉，即没有人真正关心。

sentences.en: Nobody was really paying attention or doing anything about it, including the Israelis.
sentences.zh: 没有人真正关注或为此做任何事情，包括以色列人。

sentences.en: That the Israelis just didn't even seem to be thinking about the Palestinian cause anymore.
sentences.zh: 以色列人甚至似乎根本不再考虑巴勒斯坦事业了。

sentences.en: So they felt that they needed to do something big.
sentences.zh: 所以他们觉得他们需要做一些大事。

sentences.en: They need to do something dramatic to blow up the status quo.
sentences.zh: 他们需要做一些戏剧性的事情来打破现状。

sentences.en: They wanted to completely overthrow the situation in the region.
sentences.zh: 他们想要彻底推翻该地区的局势。

sentences.en: And individual leaders said that they hoped that this led to a big regional war.
sentences.zh: 个别领导人表示，他们希望这能引发一场广大的地区战争。

sentences.en: That that was like the ideal outcome.
sentences.zh: 这就像是理想的结果。

sentences.en: And hoped that some new option would emerge from what came after.
sentences.zh: 并希望从随之而来的事情中会出现某种新的选择。

sentences.en: So what they're telling you is they needed in their minds to light a fire.
sentences.zh: 所以他们告诉你的是，在他们的心中，他们需要点燃一把火。

sentences.en: And not a small fire.
sentences.zh: 而且不是小火。

sentences.en: They wanted to light a conflagration.
sentences.zh: 他们想要点燃一场熊熊大火。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering if that means for them that any death toll on both sides was therefore worth it.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否意味着对他们来说，双方的任何死亡人数因此都是值得的？

sentences.en: Well, I asked them about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我问过他们这个问题。

sentences.en: Everybody that I talked to.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的每一个人。

sentences.en: And they give, on pretty much all counts, incredibly unsatisfying answers.
sentences.zh: 在几乎所有方面，他们给出的答案都极其令人不满意。

sentences.en: When you ask about the civilian Israelis who were killed in their communities, they basically deny it.
sentences.zh: 当你问及在他们的社区中被杀害的以色列平民时，他们基本上予以否认。

sentences.en: And say either it's not true.
sentences.zh: 并表示要么这不是真的。

sentences.en: This is Israeli propaganda.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列的宣传。

sentences.en: Or they say that if any civilians were killed, they were killed in the crossfire between our fighters and Israeli security services and the military.
sentences.zh: 或者他们说，如果有任何平民被杀，那是在我们的武装人员与以色列安全部队和军队的交火中被误杀的。

sentences.en: And there's ample evidence that show that that's just not true.
sentences.zh: 有充足的证据表明这根本不是真的。

sentences.en: There is evidence and testimony from Israeli survivors of the attacks.
sentences.zh: 有来自以色列袭击幸存者的证据和证词。

sentences.en: There is dash cam footage from cars that were parked in places where the attacks took place.
sentences.zh: 有来自袭击发生地附近停放车辆的行车记录仪画面。

sentences.en: There's surveillance footage from cameras that were posted in the communities.
sentences.zh: 有社区内部安装的摄像头的监控画面。

sentences.en: And there's even helmet cameras that some of the Hamas fighters were wearing that were captured by the Israelis after the fighters were killed.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一些哈马斯武装人员佩戴的头盔摄像头画面，这些武装人员被击毙后被以色列人缴获了。

sentences.en: And so we have that footage as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也有这些画面。

sentences.en: So all of this shows that regardless of what Hamas says,
sentences.zh: 因此，所有这一切都表明，不管哈马斯怎么说，

sentences.en: the objectives of the attack were that many of these fighters just moved deliberately through these communities in a very studied way, shooting and killing people on site.
sentences.zh: 袭击的目标是，许多这些武装人员只是以一种非常刻意的方式穿过这些社区，在现场开枪并杀害人们。

sentences.en: My colleagues have done work proving that they cornered civilians who had taken shelter inside of bomb shelters and threw grenades inside to try to kill them while they were stuck in there.
sentences.zh: 我的同事们所做的工作证明，他们将躲在防空洞内的平民逼入绝境，并把手榴弹扔进去，试图在他们被困在里面时杀死他们。

sentences.en: And there's other evidence that they just lit people's houses on fire on top of them.
sentences.zh: 还有其他证据表明，他们直接在人们的头顶上点燃了他们的房屋。

sentences.en: So we know that Hamas's denials are just not true.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道哈马斯的否认根本不是真的。

sentences.en: And when you ask them about, okay, well, there's a big war going on.
sentences.zh: 当你问他们，好吧，一场大战正在发生。

sentences.en: Obviously, we see the death toll in Gaza going up every day.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们看到加沙的死亡人数每天都在上升。

sentences.en: These are supposed to be your people.
sentences.zh: 这些人本该是你们的人民。

sentences.en: They basically say whatever Israel does is not our fault.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上说，以色列做什么都不是我们的错。

sentences.en: You know, we're out here trying to save the Palestinian cause.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在这里是为了拯救巴勒斯坦事业。

sentences.en: And if Israel decides to come back and kill a bunch of people in Gaza, like that's not our problem.
sentences.zh: 如果以色列决定回来并在加沙杀死一群人，这根本不是我们的问题。

sentences.en: So when you take a step back and look at what they're saying in the context of this broader goal,
sentences.zh: 因此，当你退一步，在这个更广泛目标的背景下看待他们的言论时，

sentences.en: they just seem to be saying that all of these deaths are just the necessary cost of this blowing up of the status quo.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎只是在说，所有这些死亡只是打破现状所必须付出的代价。

sentences.en: Ben, bottom line, to accomplish this objective of upending the status quo for Hamas, for its leaders, it seems like almost any amount of death would be allowable.
sentences.zh: 本，归根结底，为了实现对哈马斯及其领导人来说颠覆现状的目标，似乎几乎任何数量的死亡都是可以接受的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In my conversations with some of the Hamas leaders,
sentences.zh: 在我与一些哈马斯领导人的对话中，

sentences.en: there really did not seem to be a lot of hand-wringing about the number of civilian deaths that have come about because of this attack.
sentences.zh: 对于这次袭击造成的平民死亡人数，似乎真的没有多少纠结或内疚。

sentences.en: So help us better understand how that status quo that Hamas is so desperate to shatter came to be and how Hamas decided that it was willing to go to this length to destroy it.
sentences.zh: 所以请帮助我们更好地理解，哈马斯拼命想要打破的那个现状是如何形成的，以及哈马斯是如何决定愿意不惜一切代价去摧毁它的。

sentences.en: So I found it very useful in trying to understand how Hamas got to this point, looking at the career of one of the people who ended up plotting this attack.
sentences.zh: 因此，在试图理解哈马斯如何走到这一步时，我发现研究最终策划这次袭击的人之一的职业生涯非常有用。

sentences.en: And this is the head of Hamas in Gaza, whose name is Yahya Senwar.
sentences.zh: 这就是哈马斯在加沙的领导人，他的名字叫叶海亚·辛瓦尔。

sentences.en: So what should we know about him?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该了解他什么呢？

sentences.en: Yahya Senwar is from the first generation of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 叶海亚·辛瓦尔来自哈马斯的第一代人。

sentences.en: Hamas was a Palestinian militant movement founded in the late 80s that was an Islamist movement that aimed to destroy Israel with military means and replace it with a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯是80年代末成立的一个巴勒斯坦武装运动，是一个伊斯兰主义运动，旨在通过军事手段消灭以色列并将其替换为巴勒斯坦国。

sentences.en: At this time, the Israeli military was occupying the West Bank and Gaza, and Hamas was not interested in just ending the occupation of these territories.
sentences.zh: 当时，以色列军队正占领着约旦河西岸和加沙，而哈马斯并不仅仅对结束对这些领土的占领感兴趣。

sentences.en: Hamas believed that the entire state of Israel was an occupation.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯认为整个以色列国就是一种占领。

sentences.en: This sets it apart from other Palestinian movements that have negotiated with Israel and accept Israel's right to exiSt.
sentences.zh: 这使它与其他曾与以色列谈判并接受以色列生存权利的巴勒斯坦运动区分开来。

sentences.en: Hamas never accepted that and felt that the whole thing was wrong and that the only solution was to completely destroy Israel and replace it with a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯从未接受这一点，认为整个事情都是错误的，唯一的解决办法就是彻底消灭以色列并将其替换为一个巴勒斯坦国。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Senwar is from the very early generation of this movement.
sentences.zh: 所以辛瓦尔来自这个运动的极早期。

sentences.en: And from very early on, he's sort of an internal security guy.
sentences.zh: 而且从很早开始，他就是一个内部安全人员。

sentences.en: He's in charge of looking out for Israeli moles inside of the organization.
sentences.zh: 他负责防范组织内部的以色列间谍。

sentences.en: And he punishes these people with such brutality that he's given the nickname the Butcher of Khan Yunus.
sentences.zh: 他以极其残忍的手段惩罚这些人，因此得到了“汗尤尼斯屠夫”的绰号。

sentences.en: Khan Yunus is a town in Gaza where he was born, and so he was known as the Butcher of Khan Yunus.
sentences.zh: 汗尤尼斯是加沙的一个城镇，他出生在那里，所以他被称为汗尤尼斯屠夫。

sentences.en: So he's an enforcer within Hamas, a violent figure within an already violent group.
sentences.zh: 所以他是哈马斯内部的执行者，是一个本就暴力的集团内部的暴力人物。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But then in 1988, he gets arrested by the Israelis, and he is thrown in jail for the murder of four Palestinians who were alleged collaborators with Israel,
sentences.zh: 但在1988年，他被以色列人逮捕，并因谋杀四名被指控是以色列合作者、

sentences.en: spying inside of the organization.
sentences.zh: 在组织内部充当间谍的巴勒斯坦人而被投入监狱。

sentences.en: And he's in prison for 22 years.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里呆了22年。

sentences.en: And he describes this later as being very educational.
sentences.zh: 他后来将此描述为非常有教育意义的经历。

sentences.en: He learns to speak good Hebrew.
sentences.zh: 他学会说一口流利的希伯来语。

sentences.en: He reads books in Hebrew.
sentences.zh: 他阅读希伯来语的书籍。

sentences.en: And he describes it as being this great opportunity to really get to know his enemy, to understand Israeli society, to understand how Israel works and how it thinks.
sentences.zh: 他将其描述为一个极好的机会，能够真正了解他的敌人，了解以色列社会，了解以色列是如何运作的和它是如何思考的。

sentences.en: And clearly, this is because he does expect or hope that someday he's going to get out of prison and that this knowledge is going to come in useful.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这是因为他确实预料或希望有一天能出狱，而这些知识将会派上用场。

sentences.en: He's studying Israel from inside prison so that he might someday better understand, it sounds like, their weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 听起来他在监狱里从内部研究以色列，以便有朝一日更好地了解他们的弱点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So while he's in jail, Hamas expands as a movement, and it becomes basically notorious for using very, very violent techniques to try to harm Israel.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他在监狱里时，哈马斯作为一个运动不断扩张，并基本上因使用非常、非常暴力的技术来伤害以色列而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: In 2007, it gets in a huge fight with other Palestinian factions inside of Gaza and ends up taking the place over and basically exiling the Palestinian Authority.
sentences.zh: 2007年，它与加沙内部的其他巴勒斯坦派别爆发了巨大的冲突，最终接管了该地区，并基本上流放了巴勒斯坦权力机构。

sentences.en: And this puts the movement in a really new place.
sentences.zh: 这使该运动处于一个全新的境地。

sentences.en: I mean, this was a movement that was founded to do military action against Israel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个为了对以色列采取军事行动而成立的运动。

sentences.en: And suddenly, it finds itself governing in a territory.
sentences.zh: 而突然间，它发现自己在某个领土上进行统治。

sentences.en: I mean, it becomes the de facto government of a territory that now has more than 2 million Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它成为了一个现在拥有200多万巴勒斯坦人的领土的事实上的政府。

sentences.en: And so instead of just, you know, wanting to launch attacks and figure out ways to, you know, attack the Israeli military,
sentences.zh: 因此，他们不再只是想要发动袭击并寻找方法来袭击以色列军队，

sentences.en: suddenly they have to think about infrastructure and how to provide services for all these people who are technically under their rule.
sentences.zh: 突然间，他们必须考虑基础设施，以及如何为所有这些技术上受他们统治的人提供服务。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But of course, Sinwar is in prison and cannot be a part of this transformation of Hamas into the governing authority of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 但当然，辛瓦尔身在监狱，无法参与哈马斯转变为加沙执政当局的这一转型过程。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So while all this is happening on the outside, Sinwar is inside, learning Hebrew and getting to know Israel better.
sentences.zh: 所以当这一切在外部发生时，辛瓦尔在内部学习希伯来语并更好地了解以色列。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, he gets an opportunity, and basically Hamas gets an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间，他得到了一个机会，基本上哈马斯得到了一个机会。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Palestinian fighters used a tunnel to attack a border post and kidnap an Israeli soldier.
sentences.zh: 周日，巴勒斯坦武装人员利用一条地道袭击了一个边境哨所并绑架了一名以色列士兵。

sentences.en: In 2006, some Hamas fighters pop up from a tunnel on the Israeli side of the border separating Israel from Gaza,
sentences.zh: 在2006年，一些哈马斯武装人员从分隔以色列和加沙的以色列一侧边境的一条地道中钻出来，

sentences.en: and they take a soldier captive, and they drag him back to Gaza, and they hold him.
sentences.zh: 他们俘虏了一名士兵，把他拖回加沙并将其扣押。

sentences.en: The 8,500 Palestinians held captive in Israel, now in the spotlight following the militants' capture of the Israeli soldier.
sentences.zh: 在武装人员俘虏了这名以色列士兵之后，被关押在以色列的8500名巴勒斯坦人现在成为了焦点。

sentences.en: Their freedom, the single demand so far from the corporal's captors.
sentences.zh: 他们的自由，是这名下士的绑架者迄今为止的唯一要求。

sentences.en: And there are years of negotiations, and then in 2011, there's an agreement for a prisoner swap.
sentences.zh: 经过多年的谈判，在2011年，达成了一项换囚协议。

sentences.en: And in the end, Hamas trades this one Israeli soldier named Galad Sharit, and they get in return more than 1,000 Palestinians released from prison.
sentences.zh: 最终，哈马斯用这名名叫吉拉德·沙利特的以色列士兵交换了释放1000多名巴勒斯坦囚犯。

sentences.en: It was just before midday that the first coachload of Palestinian prisoners came across the Egyptian border into Rafa.
sentences.zh: 就在中午之前，第一车巴勒斯坦囚犯穿过埃及边境进入了拉法。

sentences.en: And among them is Yahya Sinwar.
sentences.zh: 而叶海亚·辛瓦尔正是其中之一。

sentences.en: Yahya Sinwar is the only one of the group's top leaders to be freed in the deal.
sentences.zh: 叶海亚·辛瓦尔是该组织最高领导层中唯一在协议中获释的人。

sentences.en: And Sinwar is one of the biggest prizes that Hamas gets out.
sentences.zh: 辛瓦尔也是哈马斯救出的最大筹码之一。

sentences.en: And then he returns to Gaza, and he receives a hero's welcome.
sentences.zh: 随后他返回加沙，并受到了英雄般的欢迎。

sentences.en: And he does this not just with this new Israel education that he's gotten while he was locked up,
sentences.zh: 他不仅带着他在狱中获得的新以色列教育回归，

sentences.en: but he also, of course, learns a lesson, which is that Israel will pay dearly to get its captives released.
sentences.zh: 当然，他也吸取了一个教训，那就是以色列会付出沉重代价来解救被扣押人员。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: 1,000 Palestinian prisoners, including himself, for a single Israeli soldier.
sentences.zh: 1000名巴勒斯坦囚犯，包括他自己，换取一名以色列士兵。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so here, you know, returns this leader with 22 years in Israeli prison, and he comes back and reintegrates into Hamas and begins his further climb up the ranks.
sentences.zh: 因此，你知道，这位在以色列监狱度过22年的领导人回来了，他回归并重新融入哈马斯，开始在组织内部进一步晋升。

sentences.en: The Palestinian group Hamas has elected a commander of its armed wing as overall leader in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦组织哈马斯已选举其武装派别指挥官为加沙地带的最高领导人。

sentences.en: And in 2017, he actually becomes the top Hamas official in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 2017年，他实际上成为了哈马斯在加沙的最高官员。

sentences.en: And in that role, he starts to transform that branch of the organization.
sentences.zh: 在这个职位上，他开始改造该组织的分支。

sentences.en: He does things to make the organization stronger.
sentences.zh: 他采取行动使该组织更加强大。

sentences.en: And interestingly, he sends certain messages implying that he's actually interested in a kind of accommodation with Israel.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他发出了一些信息，暗示他实际上有兴趣与以色列达成某种形式的妥协。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: Well, so by this point, Hamas and Israel have settled into this strange kind of violent coexistence.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到这个时候，哈马斯和以色列已经陷入了一种奇怪的暴力共存状态。

sentences.en: They're obviously incredibly hostile parties.
sentences.zh: 他们显然是极其敌对的各方。

sentences.en: Violence frequently breaks out.
sentences.zh: 暴力冲突频繁爆发。

sentences.en: In fact, entire wars break out.
sentences.zh: 事实上，全面战争也时有爆发。

sentences.en: But there's also a lot of interaction because Israel controls almost all of Gaza's borders, except, you know, a small part controlled by Egypt.
sentences.zh: 但也有很多互动，因为以色列控制了加沙几乎所有的边界，除了由埃及控制的一小部分外。

sentences.en: Most of Gaza's electricity comes from Israel.
sentences.zh: 加沙的大部分电力来自以色列。

sentences.en: Most of Gaza's commercial goods are brought in from Israel.
sentences.zh: 加沙的大部分商业货物都是从以色列引进的。

sentences.en: And so just for the place to survive, there needs to be a certain amount of interaction.
sentences.zh: 因此，仅仅为了这个地方的生存，就需要有一定程度的互动。

sentences.en: And so this strange process develops where violence frequently breaks out and Hamas will fire rockets into Israel and try to hit Israeli towns and military bases.
sentences.zh: 于是形成了这样一个奇怪的过程：暴力冲突频繁爆发，哈马斯向以色列发射火箭弹，试图打击以色列城镇和军事基地。

sentences.en: And then Israel responds with airstrikes and sometimes with assassinations of Hamas leaders inside of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 然后以色列以空袭回应，有时还暗杀加沙境内的哈马斯领导人。

sentences.en: And then mediators get involved.
sentences.zh: 接着调解员介入。

sentences.en: And while they're trying to work out a ceasefire, there's a negotiation that's not really about the larger conflict, but sort of about some of the details of the actual blockade.
sentences.zh: 当他们试图达成停火协议时，会进行一场谈判，这其实并不是关于更大的冲突，而是关于实际封锁的一些细节。

sentences.en: And, you know, Hamas is trying to find ways to loosen up this blockade to allow more goods to enter Gaza.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，哈马斯正在寻找方法来放松这种封锁，以允许更多货物进入加沙。

sentences.en: And over time, Senwar ends up giving people in the Israeli security establishment this impression that that's actually something that's important to him,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，辛瓦尔最终给以色列安全机构留下了这样一种印象：这实际上是他关心的事，

sentences.en: that he actually does want to try to make life better for the people of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他确实希望努力改善加沙人民的生活。

sentences.en: And it's not just all military all the time.
sentences.zh: 并非每时每刻都完全只有军事对抗。

sentences.en: And then in 2021, there's another war between Israel and Hamas.
sentences.zh: 然后在2021年，以色列和哈马斯之间爆发了又一场战争。

sentences.en: And after that, there's a negotiation.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，进行了谈判。

sentences.en: And again, Hamas pushes for a number of things that seem to be geared towards improving life for Gazans.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯再次推动了一系列旨在改善加沙人生活的举措。

sentences.en: They negotiate tens of millions of dollars in aid from Qatar to come in through Israel to Gaza to keep the economy functioning in the place.
sentences.zh: 他们谈判争取了数千万美元的卡塔尔援助，经由以色列进入加沙，以维持当地经济的运转。

sentences.en: They negotiate work permits to try to increase the number of work permits for Gazans to leave Gaza into Israel to work.
sentences.zh: 他们谈判争取工作许可，试图增加加沙人离开加沙前往以色列工作的名额。

sentences.en: Because there's really not a lot of jobs in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 因为加沙确实没有多少工作机会。

sentences.en: And so this is a good thing for the economy.
sentences.zh: 所以这对经济来说是一件好事。

sentences.en: And so, you know, at another point, even more recently than that, there were clashes started by other militant factions in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 因此，你知道，在另一个时间点，甚至比那更近的时候，加沙的其他武装派别挑起了冲突。

sentences.en: And Hamas sits out.
sentences.zh: 而哈马斯按兵不动。

sentences.en: They sit on the side.
sentences.zh: 他们作壁上观。

sentences.en: And so together, this creates this impression on the Israeli side that I think there's sort of two prongs to it.
sentences.zh: 因此总的来说，这在以色列方面产生了一种印象，我认为这其中包含两个方面。

sentences.en: One is that the Israeli defense technology is enough to keep Gaza contained.
sentences.zh: 其一是以色列的防御技术足以遏制加沙。

sentences.en: We have this border fence that has cameras and it has motion sensors and it has remote control machine guns.
sentences.zh: 我们有装有摄像头、运动传感器和远程控制机枪的边境隔离墙。

sentences.en: We have an underground wall, so there's no tunnels.
sentences.zh: 我们有地下墙，所以没有地道。

sentences.en: And we have Iron Dome, which is the Israeli rocket interception system.
sentences.zh: 我们有“铁穹”，这是以色列的火箭拦截系统。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, they say, well, we also have this leader in Gaza who seems like he doesn't want to get a bunch of his people killed in yet another war.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他们还说，嗯，我们在加沙还有这样一位领导人，他看起来并不想在又一场战争中让他的大批民众丧生。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It sounds like you're saying Sinwar's conduct and his messaging is contributing to this feeling inside Israel that maybe Gaza and Hamas can be contained.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，辛瓦尔的行为和传递的信息促成了以色列内部的一种感觉，即加沙和哈马斯或许是可以被遏制的。

sentences.en: This can all be managed.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是可以管控的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it's not that anybody thinks that they've managed to sort of solve the long-term conflict with Hamas.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说任何人认为他们已经设法解决了与哈马斯的长期冲突。

sentences.en: It's more that, okay, well, we've got this situation under control.
sentences.zh: 更多的是觉得，好吧，我们已经把这种局面控制住了。

sentences.en: That with our security measures to try to keep them contained and that if we can keep enough aid going in to keep the economy going along so that people aren't too miserable,
sentences.zh: 通过我们的安全措施努力遏制他们，如果我们能维持足够的援助流入以维持经济运转，使人们不至于太过悲惨，

sentences.en: that in a way this could keep things from really blowing up.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这可以防止局势彻底爆发。

sentences.en: But meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，

sentences.en: it's clear to us in hindsight that Sinwar was not at all happy with that status quo and that he was covertly working to try to build up Hamas's military capabilities inside of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，我们很清楚，辛瓦尔对现状一点也不满意，他一直在暗中努力增强哈马斯在加沙内部的军事能力。

sentences.en: Well, how so?
sentences.zh: 哦，怎么说？

sentences.en: Well, Hamas continues to build its arsenal of rockets inside of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 嗯，哈马斯继续在加沙内部建立其火箭弹库存。

sentences.en: They smuggle in the materials that they need to make them and they build them inside of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他们走私制造所需的材料，并在加沙内部进行制造。

sentences.en: So they're building up this arsenal.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正在建立这个武器库。

sentences.en: And on a more strategic level,
sentences.zh: 在更具战略的层面上，

sentences.en: Sinwar comes in and he repairs the relationship between Hamas and specifically with the Hamas military wing in Gaza and some of its older regional allies.
sentences.zh: 辛瓦尔上台后，修复了哈马斯——特别是加沙的哈马斯军事翼——与一些老牌地区盟友之间的关系。

sentences.en: The most important of these is Iran, which had been a funder and the state supporter of Hamas since the early days of the movement.
sentences.zh: 其中最重要的是伊朗，自该运动早期以来，伊朗一直是哈马斯的资金提供者和国家支持者。

sentences.en: And also with Hezbollah, the Lebanese militia,
sentences.zh: 还有黎巴嫩民兵组织真主党，

sentences.en: which is also dedicated to the destruction of Israel and works closely with Iran to try to build this sort of network of regional militias that are out to harm Israel.
sentences.zh: 该组织同样致力于消灭以色列，并与伊朗密切合作，试图建立这样一个旨在危害以色列的地区民兵网络。

sentences.en: We know that in recent years, a number of Hamas fighters have been able to get out of Gaza and travel both to Iran and to Lebanon for various kinds of training.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，近年来，许多哈马斯武装人员得以离开加沙，前往伊朗和黎巴嫩接受各种培训。

sentences.en: And looking back at this attack,
sentences.zh: 回看这次袭击，

sentences.en: we realized that they were probably learning new capabilities that really added a whole different kind of sophistication to the kinds of attacks that Hamas was able to carry out.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到他们可能正在学习新的技能，这确实为哈马斯能够发动的袭击增添了完全不同层次的复杂性。

sentences.en: So all these alliances you're describing that Sinwar deepens, they're in the service of making Hamas a stronger, more capable fighting force.
sentences.zh: 所以你所描述的辛瓦尔不断深化所有这些同盟，都是为了将哈马斯打造成一支更强大、更有能力的战斗力量。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, he clearly knows that the battle is not over.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他清楚地知道战斗尚未结束。

sentences.en: And it certainly is clear in hindsight that his end goal was not to govern Gaza and to try to improve the life of Gazans.
sentences.zh: 而且事后显然很清楚，他的最终目标不是治理加沙并试图改善加沙人民的生活。

sentences.en: But he was very interested in developing the military capabilities so that he could find a way to hit Israel in a new and powerful way.
sentences.zh: 而是对发展军事能力非常感兴趣，以便找到一种以崭新而有力的方式打击以色列的方法。

sentences.en: So what exactly sets the stage for doing just that, hitting Israel in a new and powerful way, and for doing it when Sinwar and Hamas decide to do it, on October 7th, 2023?
sentences.zh: 那么，究竟是什么为做到这一点——以一种崭新而有力的方式打击以色列，并且在辛瓦尔和哈马斯决定的时候，即在2023年10月7日发动——做好了铺垫？

sentences.en: So when I asked the Hamas leaders about this, this is where they brought up the idea that the Palestinian cause was slipping away.
sentences.zh: 所以当我问哈马斯领导人这个问题时，他们提出了巴勒斯坦事业正在逐渐消逝的想法。

sentences.en: And they point to try and they point to a number of things.
sentences.zh: 他们指出并列举了许多事情。

sentences.en: And these are issues that are not just important to Hamas.
sentences.zh: 这些不仅对哈马斯重要，

sentences.en: These are issues that are important to all Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 这些是对所有巴勒斯坦人都很重要的议题。

sentences.en: They talk about the most right-wing government in Israeli history coming to power and basically not being at all interested in talking about any future for the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到以色列历史上最右翼的政府上台，基本上对讨论巴勒斯坦人的任何未来毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: They talk about attacks by settlers in the West Bank on Palestinian communities.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到约旦河西岸的定居者对巴勒斯坦社区的袭击。

sentences.en: They talk about police raids on the Al-Aqsa Mosque, which is one of the holiest sites in Islam, which is in Jerusalem,
sentences.zh: 他们谈到对位于耶路撒冷、作为伊斯兰教最圣神圣地之一的阿克萨清真寺的警察突袭，

sentences.en: and has always been sort of a touchstone for the Palestinian claim to the city.
sentences.zh: 这里一直是巴勒斯坦人对该市主权诉求的某种试金石。

sentences.en: There's also, of course, the Israeli blockade of Gaza, which it has enforced since 2007 along with Egypt.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有自2007年以来一直与埃及共同实施的以色列对加沙的封锁。

sentences.en: And also sort of hanging over these normalization deals that are happening between Israel and other Arab countries.
sentences.zh: 还有悬在头顶的以色列与其他阿拉伯国家之间正在进行的正常化协议。

sentences.en: And this idea that Israel can go around the Palestinians and find peace with the Arabs without resolving the conflict.
sentences.zh: 以及这种想法：以色列可以绕过巴勒斯坦人，在不解决冲突的情况下与阿拉伯人实现和平。

sentences.en: And these are the things that they're talking about when they're saying, you know, we just felt like the cause was slipping away.
sentences.zh: 当他们说“我们只是觉得事业正在消逝”时，他们谈论的就是这些事情。

sentences.en: Right, because in a sense, the cause has been slipping away, right, kind of indisputably.
sentences.zh: 对，因为从某种意义上说，这项事业确实一直在消逝，对吧，可以说是无可争议的。

sentences.en: Arab countries who would be natural allies of the Palestinian cause are signing deals in which the only previous obstacle had been the fate of the Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 本应是巴勒斯坦事业天然盟友的阿拉伯国家正在签署协议，而此前唯一的障碍就是巴勒斯坦人民的命运。

sentences.en: And so in signing those deals, they're basically saying they no longer cared about the Palestinian cause.
sentences.zh: 因此，在签署这些协议时，他们基本上是在表明他们不再关心巴勒斯坦事业。

sentences.en: And as you just mentioned, there are these kind of daily insults and offenses occurring that are, if you're a Palestinian, extremely upsetting.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才提到的，每天都有各种侮辱和冒犯发生，如果你是一个巴勒斯坦人，这些会让你感到极其沮丧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so Hamas basically sees all of this happening and feels like this cause is slipping away.
sentences.zh: 因此哈马斯基本上看到了这一切的发生，觉得这项事业正在消逝。

sentences.en: And this is where they get this idea that we have to do something and we have to do something big.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们产生这种想法的原因：我们必须做点什么，而且必须做大事。

sentences.en: We cannot let this issue disappear.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能让这个问题消失。

sentences.en: We have to bring it back to the world's attention.
sentences.zh: 我们必须把它重新带回世界的视野中。

sentences.en: And that's what gets us to October 7th.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们迎来10月7日的原因。

sentences.en: Ben, what have you learned through this reporting you have been doing about how under Sinwar, Hamas planned and thought about the scope of what became the October 7th attack?
sentences.zh: 本，通过你一直在做的报道，对于在辛瓦尔领导下，哈马斯如何策划以及如何思考10月7日袭击事件的规模，你了解到了什么？

sentences.en: So we know that they basically felt that the old model was not going to be good enough.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道，他们基本上认为旧的模式已经不够用了。

sentences.en: That this idea that they would fire rockets and try to hit Israeli communities and whatever.
sentences.zh: 那种发射火箭弹试图打击以色列社区之类的想法。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: This had to be much, much bigger.
sentences.zh: 这必须规模宏大得多。

sentences.en: And so they wanted to take the fight to the Israelis.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想把战斗直接带给以色列人。

sentences.en: They wanted to get out of Gaza and not just a few of them, but large numbers of them.
sentences.zh: 他们想离开加沙，不是少数几个人，而是大量人员。

sentences.en: And they wanted it to be an incredibly dramatic attack.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这是一场极其戏剧化的袭击。

sentences.en: And so they went by air.
sentences.zh: 所以他们走空中。

sentences.en: They went by land.
sentences.zh: 他们走陆地。

sentences.en: They went by sea.
sentences.zh: 他们走海上。

sentences.en: They went inside of Israeli military bases.
sentences.zh: 他们进入以色列军事基地内部。

sentences.en: They went inside Israeli communities and killed a lot of people and took a lot of prisoners.
sentences.zh: 他们进入以色列社区内部，杀害了许多人，并抓走了许多俘虏。

sentences.en: And they managed to bring a lot of these hostages back to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他们设法将许多人质带回了加沙。

sentences.en: And Sinwar knows better than anybody how much the taking of one Israeli captive can change the situation.
sentences.zh: 没有人比辛瓦尔更清楚劫持一名以色列人质能多大程度上改变局势。

sentences.en: And we know that when they launched this attack, they were seeking captives.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，当他们发动这次袭击时，他们就是在寻找人质。

sentences.en: They wanted to find people and bring them back to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他们想要找到人并把他们带回加沙。

sentences.en: And we also know that this attack was much, much more successful than even its plotters had anticipated.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，这次袭击的成功程度远超策划者的预期。

sentences.en: And so now the fact that Hamas, instead of just one Israeli captive, has somewhere around 240,
sentences.zh: 所以现在，哈马斯扣押的不是一个以色列人质，而是大约240人左右，这一事实

sentences.en: it just pushes the entire conflict into this uncharted territory where nobody really knows what comes next.
sentences.zh: 直接将整个冲突推向了一个未知的领域，没有人真正知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk more about the aftermath of this brutal attack and how, Ben, in your reporting, you've been trying to understand whether Hamas did what it set out to do,
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们多谈谈这场残酷袭击的余波，以及本，在你的报道中，你一直试图弄清楚哈马斯是否达到了它的目标，

sentences.en: given the original aims, as you have described and reported them, of exploding a status quo.
sentences.zh: 考虑到你所描述和报道的打破现状的最初目标。

sentences.en: I mean, how should we think about measuring this idea, this complicated idea, that this was, to use Hamas's word, a success?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们应该如何看待衡量这个想法——这个复杂的想法，即用哈马斯的话说，这是一次成功？

sentences.en: Well, I think in the fundamental sense of setting out to shatter the status quo, then, yeah, this accomplished that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为从打破现状的根本意义上来说，是的，这做到了。

sentences.en: Gaza's never going to go back to what it was.
sentences.zh: 加沙再也回不到过去的样子了。

sentences.en: I think in terms of the goal of putting the Palestinian cause back on the table, I think it was true that not many people were paying attention to it just over a month ago.
sentences.zh: 我认为就将巴勒斯坦问题重新提上议程的目标而言，一个月前确实没有多少人关注它。

sentences.en: And now, because of Israel's ferocious response to the Hamas attacks and the bombing of Gaza, you know,
sentences.zh: 而现在，由于以色列对哈马斯袭击的凶猛回击以及对加沙的轰炸，你知道，

sentences.en: now we're seeing protests coming out all over the world and different cities in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在我们看到世界各地以及美国不同城市的抗议活动纷纷涌现，

sentences.en: talking about Palestinian rights in a way that we have not seen before.
sentences.zh: 以我们从未见过的方式讨论巴勒斯坦权利。

sentences.en: And there's also this sort of frantic diplomacy that started, and you have U.S.
sentences.zh: 还有这种突然开始的狂热外交，美国

sentences.en: Secretary of State, Anthony Blinken, flying around and talking about the two-state solution and how to make progress on it.
sentences.zh: 国务卿安东尼·布林肯四处奔走，谈论两国方案以及如何在上面取得进展。

sentences.en: And so, the issue is on the table in a way that it was not before this attack.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个问题以一种袭击发生前所没有的方式被摆上了台面。

sentences.en: And then in terms of this idea of sparking this big regional war, that has not happened, at least not to the extent that Hamas had hoped.
sentences.zh: 至于引发这场大规模地区战争的想法，目前还没有发生，至少没有达到哈马斯希望的程度。

sentences.en: There has been fighting on the Lebanese border with Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 黎巴嫩边境与真主党一直在发生战斗。

sentences.en: There have been attacks in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克也发生过袭击事件。

sentences.en: But we have not seen this sort of huge uprising and the rest of the Arabs kind of joining the cause to come and try to help Hamas destroy Israel.
sentences.zh: 但我们没有看到那种大规模的起义，也没有看到其他阿拉伯国家加入这个阵营，试图帮助哈马斯摧毁以色列。

sentences.en: Ben, that feels important to dwell on for just a moment.
sentences.zh: 本，这一点感觉很重要，值得我们稍微深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: If Hamas's militant allies in the Middle East, Hezbollah, for example, don't become more involved in this conflict,
sentences.zh: 如果哈马斯在中东的激进盟友，例如真主党，没有更多地卷入这场冲突，

sentences.en: will that be a signal that the Palestinian cause is not likely to stay top of mind for very long?
sentences.zh: 这是否会是一个信号，表明巴勒斯坦问题不太可能长期占据人们关注的核心？

sentences.en: And then ultimately, one of the main objectives of October 7th will have failed.
sentences.zh: 那么最终，10月7日的主要目标之一就宣告失败了。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the most surprising things, I think, for me about all of this is that Iran and its regional militias,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对我来说，关于这一切最令人惊讶的事情之一就是伊朗及其地区民兵，

sentences.en: including Hamas, had been talking for a long time about how they had built this axis of resistance
sentences.zh: 包括哈马斯，长期以来一直在谈论他们如何建立这个抵抗之弧，

sentences.en: and how they were much more integrated and they were sharing technology and sharing information.
sentences.zh: 以及他们是如何更加一体化、如何分享技术和信息的。

sentences.en: And there's this idea that they had put out that if there was a war against Israel,
sentences.zh: 他们曾散布这样一种观点：如果爆发针对以色列的战争，

sentences.en: all the pieces would fall into place and it would be like this big sort of militant Voltron that would come together and fight Israel.
sentences.zh: 所有的棋子都会各就各位，这将像是一个巨大的武装战神金刚，集结起来与以色列作战。

sentences.en: And that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: I was quite surprised in the reporting that we don't have any indications that Hamas coordinated this attack with anybody or that they let anybody know that it was coming.
sentences.zh: 在采访中我相当惊讶地发现，没有任何迹象表明哈马斯曾与任何人协调这次袭击，也没有让任何人知道袭击即将到来。

sentences.en: Hezbollah's response was quite cautious at the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 真主党最初的反应相当谨慎。

sentences.en: They're now clashing with Israel on the border, but they've done it in sort of a controlled way to keep it from escalating into a bigger war.
sentences.zh: 他们现在正在边境与以色列交火，但他们采取了一种受控的方式，以防止其升级为更大规模的战争。

sentences.en: And so it sort of raises this whole question of this idea of this big regional militia network.
sentences.zh: 所以这就引发了关于这个大型地区民兵网络概念的整个问题。

sentences.en: Well, maybe it's not as coordinated as we thought.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许它并不像我们想象的那么协调一致。

sentences.en: I mean, if Hamas is actually going to be the one to pull the plug on this big war and these other guys don't actually want to join it in the same way that Hamas is doing it,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果哈马斯实际上是那个要拉闸引爆这场大战的人，而其他家伙并不想以哈马斯那样的方式真正加入进来，

sentences.en: then maybe this network is not as tight as we expected it was.
sentences.zh: 那么这个网络可能并不像我们预期的那么紧密。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So yes, Hamas has put the question of the Palestinians back on people's minds, whether it's demonstrators or like Blinken, diplomats.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，哈马斯确实让人们重新关注巴勒斯坦人的问题，无论是示威者还是像布林肯这样的外交官。

sentences.en: But to what end?
sentences.zh: 但这究竟是为了什么？

sentences.en: I mean, ideally, from the point of view of Hamas, the end is a Palestinian state and the elimination of Israel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，理想情况下，从哈马斯的角度来看，最终目的是建立一个巴勒斯坦国并消灭以色列。

sentences.en: It seems like Hamas is no closer to that now than they were before October 7th.
sentences.zh: 看起来哈马斯现在距离这个目标并不比10月7日之前更近。

sentences.en: So in Hamas's mind, what is supposed to be on the other side of the status quo that's gone
sentences.zh: 所以在哈马斯看来，打破现状之后，应该迎来的会是什么呢？

sentences.en: other than Israeli death and Israeli suffering and Palestinian death and Palestinian suffering on an enormous scale?
sentences.zh: 除了大规模的以色列人死亡与痛苦，以及巴勒斯坦人死亡与痛苦之外？

sentences.en: In my talks with the Hamas leaders, there was really no sense of a grand plan for what comes next.
sentences.zh: 在我与哈马斯领导人的交谈中，对于下一步该怎么做，确实没有什么宏伟计划的概念。

sentences.en: First, they definitely wanted to hit Israel as hard as they could, and they wanted to hit Israel inside of Israel.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们绝对想尽可能狠狠地打击以色列，而且他们想在以色列境内打击以色列。

sentences.en: And they were not particularly concerned about what sort of response this would bring and what it would mean to the people of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是特别关心这会引发什么样的反应，以及这对加沙人民意味着什么。

sentences.en: It was that the attack somehow would be enough and would open up some new way.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这次袭击本身就足够了，会开辟某种新的道路。

sentences.en: Now that we're five weeks into this, I think it's also worth pointing out that
sentences.zh: 现在我们已经进入第五周，我认为同样值得指出的是，

sentences.en: Israel doesn't appear to have a grand plan either.
sentences.zh: 以色列似乎也没有什么宏伟计划。

sentences.en: The stated goal is to destroy Hamas, and Israel can probably make a lot of progress on that.
sentences.zh: 其宣称的目标是消灭哈马斯，以色列或许能在这一方面取得很大进展。

sentences.en: They could kill a lot of the Hamas leaders, they can degrade its military capabilities.
sentences.zh: 他们可以杀死许多哈马斯领导人，他们可以削弱其军事能力。

sentences.en: But then what?
sentences.zh: 但接下来呢？

sentences.en: There's not really any plan for who's going to run Gaza once this is all over.
sentences.zh: 对于这一切结束后由谁来管理加沙，其实没有任何计划。

sentences.en: And so where does all this get us?
sentences.zh: 所以这一切把我们带到了什么地步？

sentences.en: I mean, I think, you know, it's difficult to tell the future, but there's a few possibilities.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为，你知道，预测未来很难，但有几种可能性。

sentences.en: One is that the violence gets so bad and destruction gets so great that people get sort of disgusted with it and decide that there has to be some new way forward.
sentences.zh: 一种是暴力变得如此严重，破坏变得如此巨大，以至于人们对它感到厌恶，并认为必须有某种前进的新途径。

sentences.en: There has to be a new way to try to figure out how to keep this cycle from continuing.
sentences.zh: 必须有一种新方法来设法阻止这个循环继续下去。

sentences.en: But it's also sadly possible that Israel will go in and do whatever it feels that it needs to do in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 但也可悲的是，另一种可能是以色列会进入加沙并做任何它觉得需要做的事情，

sentences.en: and the world could move on, and people could go back to forgetting about the Palestinians, and, you know, we could end up in a kind of status quo like we had before,
sentences.zh: 而世界可能会继续前进，人们可能会重新开始遗忘巴勒斯坦人，而且，你知道，我们最终可能会陷入某种类似于以前的现状，

sentences.en: but one that's even worse for the people of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 但对加沙人民来说甚至更糟糕的现状。

sentences.en: And Israel has been trying to destroy Hamas for a long time, and this time they may make a lot of progress.
sentences.zh: 以色列长期以来一直试图消灭哈马斯，这一次他们可能会取得很大进展。

sentences.en: They may kill a lot of their leaders, and they may degrade their military capabilities, but there's still going to be two million Palestinians living in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 他们可能会杀死许多领导人，可能会削弱其军事能力，但加沙仍将生活着两百万巴勒斯坦人，

sentences.en: and most of them are children.
sentences.zh: 而且他们大多数是儿童。

sentences.en: And after all the trauma of living through a war like this, it's just very hard to imagine that they're going to grow up
sentences.zh: 在经历这样一场战争的所有创伤之后，实在很难想象他们长大后会

sentences.en: and feel like they want to live peacefully next door with Israel.
sentences.zh: 觉得想要与以色列和平毗邻而居。

sentences.en: And it's certainly not hard to imagine that some other organization could come up and that it's not going to have a hard time finding recruits.
sentences.zh: 而且完全不难想象，可能会有另一个组织崛起，并且它不会难以为其招募新成员。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: What you're describing is a potential new status quo, replacing this shattered status quo that is worse for the people in Gaza and, in theory, potentially worse for Israel.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的是一种潜在的新现状，它取代了这个破碎的现状，对加沙人民来说更糟糕，从理论上讲，对以色列来说也可能更糟糕。

sentences.en: Yes, I think that's the worst-case scenario for how this could all end.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是这一切如何结局的最坏情况。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Ben.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢你，本。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
